summary: VieNeu-TTS là mô hình Text-to-speech tiếng Việt dựa trên deep learning, hỗ trợ clone giọng nói tức instant và inference trên CPU thực thời với chất lượng audio 48kHz.
usecases: Instant Vietnamese voice cloning for content creation and virtual assistants.
On-device real-time TTS for privacy-focused apps without cloud dependency.
Real-time audio generation for interactive apps, education, or accessibility tools.
ideas: Build a local Vietnamese TTS keyboard extension for messaging apps.
Create a real-time language learning platform with AI-generated pronunciation.
Combine with speech-to-text for a closed-loop Vietnamese voice assistant system.
